housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of EUR 768.40 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Genoa city centre. A deposit norm and main local rental portal were not verified.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo's official page says opening its online current account requires a valid identity card, driving licence, or passport plus a valid Italian tax code or health card.
required_docs: valid identity card, driving licence, or passport
valid Italian tax code or health card

schools.summary: The International School of Genoa states that it is an IB Continuum School offering the Primary Years Programme, Middle Years Programme, and Diploma Programme; the official IB school finder is provided as the directory.

legal_admin.summary: A person moving to Genoa from abroad must submit a completed and signed residence declaration to the Comune di Genova within 20 days of moving.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the completed and signed residence declaration to the Comune di Genova within 20 days of the transfer.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. Depending on their route, foreign citizens may receive it from an immigration desk or police headquarters; first-time foreign applicants who need the Revenue Agency must attend an in-person appointment with the required identity documentation.

transport.summary: AMT's Genoa urban network includes buses, metro, funiculars, lifts, and rack railway; its monthly pass costs EUR 48. Driving-licence exchange and healthcare-registration details were not included because they require separate authority sources beyond this schema's single service source URL.
